name: Kettlebell swing
cues: Hinge and hike the bell back between your legs
Snap your hips forward to float the bell
Let your arms guide the bell and not lift it
Let it fall back and hinge again, back flat

name: Kettlebell goblet squat
cues: Hold the kettlebell by the horns at your chest
Elbows point down between your knees
Sit deep with your chest up
Stand by pushing through your whole foot

name: Kettlebell deadlift
cues: Stand over the bell with feet about hip width
Hinge and grip the handle with a flat back
Push the floor away to stand
Squeeze your glutes at the top

name: Double kettlebell front squat
cues: Rack both bells with elbows tucked at your ribs
Brace your trunk and stay tall
Sit between your hips
Stand up without letting the bells drop forward

name: Kettlebell reverse lunge
cues: Hold the kettlebell at your chest or in the rack
Step back and lower your back knee
Keep your front heel down
Push through the front foot to stand

name: Kettlebell single-leg deadlift
cues: Hold the bell in the hand opposite your standing leg
Hinge and extend your back leg
Keep your hips square to the floor
Squeeze your glute to stand tall

name: Kettlebell clean
cues: Hike the bell back like a swing
Drive your hips forward and pull the bell close
Rotate your hand around it to the rack position
Land it softly on your forearm and chest

name: Kettlebell snatch
cues: Hike the bell back and drive your hips forward
Pull the handle high and close to your body
Punch your hand through at the top
Lock out overhead with your arm by your ear

name: Kettlebell overhead press
cues: Start with the bell in the rack position
Squeeze your glutes and brace
Press straight up, keeping your wrist straight
Lower to the rack with your elbow near your ribs

name: Kettlebell push press
cues: Rack the bell at your shoulder
Dip your knees a few inches and drive up
Press the bell overhead as your legs extend
Lower it back to the rack under control

name: One-arm kettlebell row
cues: Hinge with your free hand on your knee or a bench
Keep your back flat
Row the bell toward your hip
Lower until your arm is straight

name: Kettlebell floor press
cues: Lie on the floor with the bell in one hand
Keep your forearm vertical
Lower until your upper arm touches the floor
Press back up without shifting your wrist

name: Kettlebell windmill
cues: Press the bell overhead and watch it
Turn your back foot out and push your hip toward the bell
Hinge down the opposite leg with a straight back
Return to standing the same way

name: Kettlebell Turkish get-up
cues: Keep your eyes on the bell and your arm vertical
Move slowly through each position
Brace and keep your wrist straight
Reverse the steps to lie back down

name: Kettlebell halo
cues: Hold the bell upside down by the horns at chest height
Circle it around your head, keeping it close
Keep your ribs down and your neck relaxed
Reverse the direction every set

name: Kettlebell overhead triceps extension
cues: Hold the bell by the horns overhead
Keep your elbows pointing forward
Lower behind your head under control
Extend back to straight arms
